title: Procore’s AI could read the blueprints. For $845M, it just bought eyes on the site.
excerpt: Procore’s AI can read a construction project’s paperwork. Now it is paying $845m to give that AI eyes on the actual site. The construction-software company said it will buy DroneDeploy, a reality-capture and robotics firm, for about $84
content_html:
Procore’s AI can read a construction project’s paperwork. Now it is paying $845m to give that AI eyes on the actual site.

The construction-software company said it will buy DroneDeploy, a reality-capture and robotics firm, for about $845m in cash, Procore announced. DroneDeploy’s drones, ground robots and cameras are used on more than 3 million jobsites in over 180 countries.

Eyes for the digital coworker

Procore has spent the year building AI agents it calls digital coworkers. They handle construction paperwork: requests for information, submittals, safety reviews. Last week it expanded the line to 20 agents. One customer, the design-build firm Haskell, says it cut submittal reviews from seven days to ten minutes.

The catch is that agents reading documents are half-blind. They know what the plans say, not what the site looks like. DroneDeploy supplies the missing sense. It captures 3D imagery from the air and the ground. The AI can then compare the plan with the physical build and flag problems early.

Procore frames the goal plainly. “Adding DroneDeploy’s technology into the Procore platform will… deliver digital coworkers that track what’s happening on a project, make sense of it, and then take action to change the outcome,” said chief executive Ajei Gopal.

The prize is the data

The real asset is what the two companies can see together. Procore brings a record of construction decisions: nearly 400 million photos and more than 126 million drawings. It also logged over 10 million requests, submittals and inspections in the past year. DroneDeploy brings roughly 20 trillion square feet of visual data and more than 100,000 labelled safety issues.

That scale matters for AI. As Procore puts it, access to the right data is what separates a demo from a mission-critical product. It is the same bet playing out across industrial AI and robotics. Whoever holds the real-world data trains the better model.

Bought on a good day

The timing was pointed. Procore announced the deal the same afternoon it reported its second-quarter results. Those showed its first GAAP operating profit, and revenue up 16% to $375m. A newly profitable company can spend on a big cash deal.

The driver underneath is a labour shortage. Construction cannot hire enough skilled field workers. So Procore is pitching cameras, drones and robots that inspect a site on their own. It is automation aimed at the physical jobsite, not the office.

The deal should close later this year, subject to regulatory approval, and Procore’s guidance does not yet include DroneDeploy. If the integration works, Procore gets the full loop it has chased. It would have an AI that sees the site, understands it, and acts. No human has to walk the floor first.

content_html_zh:
Procore 的人工智能可以阅读建筑项目的文书工作。 现在，它支付了 8.45 亿美元，让人工智能监控实际网站。

Procore 宣布，这家建筑软件公司表示将以约 8.45 亿美元现金收购现实捕捉和机器人公司 DroneDeploy。 DroneDeploy 的无人机、地面机器人和摄像头在 180 多个国家的超过 300 万个工作地点使用。

关注数字化同事

Procore 花了一年的时间来构建人工智能代理，它称之为数字同事。 他们处理建筑文书工作：信息请求、提交、安全审查。 上周，该公司将代理队伍扩大到 20 名。 设计建造公司 Haskell 的一位客户表示，该公司将提交审核时间从 7 天缩短到了 10 分钟。

问题是，阅读文件的特工是半盲的。 他们知道计划怎么说，但不知道网站是什么样子。 DroneDeploy 提供了缺失的感觉。 它从空中和地面捕捉 3D 图像。 然后，人工智能可以将该计划与物理构建进行比较，并尽早标记问题。

Procore 明确地设定了目标。 “将 DroneDeploy 的技术添加到 Procore 平台中将...... 提供数字化同事来跟踪项目中发生的情况，理解项目，然后采取行动改变结果，”首席执行官 Ajei Gopal 说道。

奖品是数据

真正的资产是两家公司可以共同看到的东西。 Procore 带来了施工决策记录：近 4 亿张照片和超过 1.26 亿张图纸。 去年，它还记录了超过 1000 万次请求、提交和检查。 DroneDeploy 带来了大约 20 万亿平方英尺的视觉数据和超过 100,000 个标记的安全问题。

这种规模对于人工智能来说很重要。 正如 Procore 所说，访问正确的数据是演示与关键任务产品的区别。 工业人工智能和机器人领域也面临着同样的赌注。 谁掌握了现实世界的数据，谁就能训练出更好的模型。

在美好的一天买的

时机已经明确。 Procore 在公布第二季度业绩的同一天下午宣布了这项交易。 这些数据显示了其首次 GAAP 营业利润，收入增长 16% 至 3.75 亿美元。 一家刚刚盈利的公司可以花大额现金交易。

背后的驱动因素是劳动力短缺。 建筑业无法雇用足够的熟练现场工人。 因此，Procore 正在推出能够自行检查现场的摄像机、无人机和机器人。 它是针对实际工作现场而不是办公室的自动化。

该交易将于今年晚些时候完成，需获得监管部门的批准，并且 Procore 的指导意见尚未包括 DroneDeploy。 如果集成有效，Procore 就会获得它所追踪的完整循环。 它将有一个人工智能来查看该网站、理解它并采取行动。 没有人必须先走在地板上。
